source.citation: Corpuz, M. N. C., Nacorda, H. M. E., Casal, C. M. E., Faustino-Eslava, D. V., Jaranilla-Sanchez, P. A., & Espaldon, M. V. O. (2025). AACL Bioflux, 18(4), 1650-1662.
source.licenseEvidence: Publisher PDF states open access under Creative Commons Attribution License and requires author/source credit.
source.siteDesign: Three rivers; upstream, midstream and downstream sections; nine stations per river, three stations per section.
source.localityLimits: The paper describes river-mouth locations and reports sampled reaches, but this table does not provide per-record collection coordinates. Do not map rows to river-mouth points or infer validated reach geometry.
source.salinityLimits: The paper discusses tidal/brackish influence at lower reaches; no whole-river salinity class is inferred. The paper says salinity was excluded from the multivariate analysis after correlation screening.

interpretation: Research ledger only. Table 2 records historical presence for the three named river systems; it is not a current checklist or a validated river-reach map. The source's taxonomic names are preserved verbatim and Catalog of Fishes matches remain nomenclatural proposals, not proof that the authors identified each fish correctly.
nextStep: Review independent identification evidence and source-era river reach mapping. Keep all records research-only until identity, locality and regional rights checks pass.
